title: Activer, désactiver et ordonner les lumières et les volets depuis l'app iPhone

coverage_must_test: layout is read from the cloud route
layout is read from the local route in lan mode
default layout keeps the catalogue order and shows everything
old server 404 shows the full catalogue without message
incomplete order and unknown ids are tolerated
a lost connection keeps the last layout read
disabled light is hidden and absent from the group command
order applies inside each group and never moves an item between groups
shutters follow the chosen order in the list and the travel time card
light timers follow the global order and skip disabled lights
save is one put on the admin cloud path with the complete order
original order sends reset true and reenables everything
error messages for 400 403 503 are clear and keep the draft
move swaps with the neighbour of the same group
layout never orders the armoire and keeps names and indices NR ios 27

release.changelog_entry: iPhone : activation, désactivation et ordre d'affichage des lumières et des volets, gérés par l'administrateur de l'armoire (#49).
